opening.text: I've come in because I have pain. It came on slowly, and it feels tender, pulling, cramping, and exhausting. I'd rate the intensity about 5 out of 10. I'm also quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe. I'm tired all the time or my sleep isn't restful, and I feel lightheaded and dizzy or faint. I have chronic kidney failure and I'm taking one of the new oral blood thinners, a NOAC. Also, someone in my family has been diagnosed with anemia.
